# Lab 3.7: CDC Upserts into BigQuery

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a table with a primary key and `max_staleness`, then stream UPSERT and DELETE changes using the `_CHANGE_TYPE` pseudo-column.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create a CDC-ready table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab03.customers_cdc (
  customer_id INT64 NOT NULL,
  name STRING,
  city STRING,
  PRIMARY KEY (customer_id) NOT ENFORCED
)
CLUSTER BY customer_id
OPTIONS (max_staleness = INTERVAL 10 MINUTE);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Compile a proto that includes `_CHANGE_TYPE`.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; customer_cdc.proto &lt;&lt;'EOF'
syntax = "proto2";
message CustomerCdc {
  optional int64 customer_id = 1;
  optional string name = 2;
  optional string city = 3;
  optional string _CHANGE_TYPE = 4;
}
EOF
python3 -m grpc_tools.protoc -I. --python_out=. customer_cdc.proto</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Stream changes to the default stream.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; cdc.py &lt;&lt;'EOF'
import os
from google.cloud import bigquery_storage_v1
from google.cloud.bigquery_storage_v1 import types, writer
from google.protobuf import descriptor_pb2
import customer_cdc_pb2

client = bigquery_storage_v1.BigQueryWriteClient()
parent = client.table_path(os.environ["PROJECT_ID"], "lab03", "customers_cdc")
template = types.AppendRowsRequest(write_stream=f"{parent}/streams/_default")
d = descriptor_pb2.DescriptorProto()
customer_cdc_pb2.CustomerCdc.DESCRIPTOR.CopyToProto(d)
template.proto_rows = types.AppendRowsRequest.ProtoData(writer_schema=types.ProtoSchema(proto_descriptor=d))
stream = writer.AppendRowsStream(client, template)

changes = [(1, "Asha", "Surat", "UPSERT"), (2, "Ravi", "Pune", "UPSERT"),
           (1, "Asha", "Mumbai", "UPSERT"), (2, None, None, "DELETE")]
rows = types.ProtoRows()
for cid, name, city, ct in changes:
    msg = customer_cdc_pb2.CustomerCdc(customer_id=cid)
    if name: msg.name = name
    if city: msg.city = city
    setattr(msg, "_CHANGE_TYPE", ct)
    rows.serialized_rows.append(msg.SerializeToString())
print(stream.send(types.AppendRowsRequest(proto_rows=types.AppendRowsRequest.ProtoData(rows=rows))).result())
stream.close()
EOF
python3 cdc.py</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

5. **[Console] Check the table options.** Open `customers_cdc → Details`. See **Max staleness: 10 minutes** and the primary key. A larger staleness means cheaper, less frequent background merges.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| UPSERT | Insert or replace by primary key |
| DELETE | Removes the row |
| `max_staleness` | Trades freshness for cost |
| Final table | 1 row: Asha, Mumbai |
